ui.agents.starters.server_unanswered.role: Fallback error line for a failed individual install with no exception message
ui.agents.starters.server_unanswered.tone: Neutral failure statement; do not promise a retry.
ui.agents.starters.server_unanswered.length_hint: One short error sentence under the failed built-in name.
ui.agents.starters.server_unanswered.note: Used only when a thrown error has no readable message. It is not a progress or success status.

ui.agents.starters.summary.installed.role: Successfully installed-count clause in the final batch receipt
ui.agents.starters.summary.installed.tone: Lowercase outcome fragment, no terminal punctuation.
ui.agents.starters.summary.installed.length_hint: Compact clause in one summary sentence, about 11 characters plus digits.
ui.agents.starters.summary.installed.note: One successful-install bucket, omitted when zero. Joined with other nonempty clauses using summary.separator; summary.sentence supplies the final period.
ui.agents.starters.summary.installed.plural_guidance: Use CLDR branches needed by the target language (for example ru/pl few and many; ar zero, two, few and many). Keep {count} ungrouped in every branch: use the plain argument, never # or {count, number}, to preserve identifier-like receipt counts.

placeholders.count: Number of successful new installations; nonnegative integer. Numeric plural selector; print it ungrouped via {count}.

ui.agents.starters.summary.already_prese.role: Already-installed-count clause in the final batch receipt
ui.agents.starters.summary.already_prese.tone: Lowercase no-op outcome fragment, not a new-install claim.
ui.agents.starters.summary.already_prese.length_hint: Compact clause in one summary sentence, about 17 characters plus digits.
ui.agents.starters.summary.already_prese.note: Counts built-ins the backend reported already present, not successful new copies. Omitted when zero; joined with other clauses, no period here.
ui.agents.starters.summary.already_prese.plural_guidance: Use CLDR branches needed by the target language (for example ru/pl few and many; ar zero, two, few and many). Keep {count} ungrouped in every branch: use the plain argument, never # or {count, number}, to preserve identifier-like receipt counts.

placeholders.count: Number of idempotent already-present outcomes; nonnegative integer. Numeric plural selector; print it ungrouped via {count}.

ui.agents.starters.summary.skipped.role: Name-collision-count clause in the final batch receipt
ui.agents.starters.summary.skipped.tone: Lowercase skipped-outcome fragment; do not call it success.
ui.agents.starters.summary.skipped.length_hint: Compact clause in one summary sentence, about 9 characters plus digits.
ui.agents.starters.summary.skipped.note: Counts names owned by other local agents. Omitted when zero; joined with other clauses. Detailed names follow in summary.collisions.
ui.agents.starters.summary.skipped.plural_guidance: Use CLDR branches needed by the target language (for example ru/pl few and many; ar zero, two, few and many). Keep {count} ungrouped in every branch: use the plain argument, never # or {count, number}, to preserve identifier-like receipt counts.

placeholders.count: Number of names skipped because another local agent owns them; nonnegative integer. Numeric plural selector; print it ungrouped via {count}.

ui.agents.starters.summary.failed.role: Failed-install-count clause in the final batch receipt
ui.agents.starters.summary.failed.tone: Lowercase failure fragment, separate from skipped names.
ui.agents.starters.summary.failed.length_hint: Compact clause in one summary sentence, about 8 characters plus digits.
ui.agents.starters.summary.failed.note: Counts install errors other than a name collision. Omitted when zero; joined with other clauses. Each failure also gets its own server-message line.
ui.agents.starters.summary.failed.plural_guidance: Use CLDR branches needed by the target language (for example ru/pl few and many; ar zero, two, few and many). Keep {count} ungrouped in every branch: use the plain argument, never # or {count, number}, to preserve identifier-like receipt counts.

placeholders.count: Number of failed attempts excluding name collisions; nonnegative integer. Numeric plural selector; print it ungrouped via {count}.

ui.agents.starters.summary.empty.role: Receipt contents for a batch with no counted outcomes
ui.agents.starters.summary.empty.tone: Brief neutral result, initial capital, no period.
ui.agents.starters.summary.empty.length_hint: One short result clause, about 18 English characters.
ui.agents.starters.summary.empty.note: Used as the sole parts value when all buckets are empty; summary.sentence appends the period. Not the initial uninstalled-agents empty state.

ui.agents.starters.summary.sentence.role: Final punctuation wrapper around batch receipt clauses
ui.agents.starters.summary.sentence.length_hint: Single summary line; may wrap if many outcome buckets exist.
ui.agents.starters.summary.sentence.note: Owns the final period. Individual outcome clauses must not add their own periods; empty-result copy also passes through this wrapper.

placeholders.parts: Ordered nonempty localized outcome fragments joined with summary.separator, or the summary.empty string; no terminal period yet.

ui.agents.starters.summary.separator.role: Separator joining nonempty outcome clauses in batch receipt
ui.agents.starters.summary.separator.tone: Composition punctuation only, not standalone copy.
ui.agents.starters.summary.separator.length_hint: Two characters in English, comma followed by a space.
ui.agents.starters.summary.separator.note: Separates ordered installed, already-present, skipped and failed fragments. Do not add terminal punctuation; summary.sentence owns that.

ui.agents.starters.summary.collisions.role: Additional receipt sentence naming skipped built-ins
ui.agents.starters.summary.collisions.tone: Factual name-collision explanation; not a failure or install success.
ui.agents.starters.summary.collisions.length_hint: Paragraph beneath the summary, wraps for many quoted names.
ui.agents.starters.summary.collisions.note: Only shown for one or more skipped names. Explain that the user already holds local agents with these names; do not translate the names themselves.
ui.agents.starters.summary.collisions.plural_guidance: Use CLDR branches needed by the target language (for example ru/pl few and many; ar zero, two, few and many). Keep {count} ungrouped in every branch: use the plain argument, never # or {count, number}, to preserve identifier-like receipt counts.

placeholders.count: Number of skipped names, equal to the number of entries in names; positive integer. Numeric plural selector; print it ungrouped via {count}.
placeholders.names: Comma-and-space-joined canonical names, each already wrapped in straight double quotes; interpolate unchanged.
placeholders.name: Canonical built-in identifier currently being installed; unchanged and unquoted here.

ui.agents.starters.action.all_builtins.role: Empty-agents shortcut button that starts installing every built-in
ui.agents.starters.action.all_builtins.tone: Clear action verb and built-in scope.
ui.agents.starters.action.all_builtins.length_hint: One compact small button label, about 27 English characters.
ui.agents.starters.action.all_builtins.note: Shown when the host sidebar has no user agents; starts the batch rather than opening the public hub.

ui.agents.starters.available.role: Available-built-in count in populated-sidebar install shortcut
ui.agents.starters.available.tone: Quiet availability status, not an installed count.
ui.agents.starters.available.length_hint: One row beside action.all_count; compact count and noun, about 26 characters plus digits.
ui.agents.starters.available.note: Names how many packaged built-ins the local backend offers. These can include already-installed profiles; this is not the success receipt.
ui.agents.starters.available.plural_guidance: Use CLDR branches needed by the target language (for example ru/pl few and many; ar zero, two, few and many). Keep {count} ungrouped in every branch: use the plain argument, never # or {count, number}, to preserve identifier-like receipt counts.

placeholders.count: Total available packaged built-ins, not installed outcomes; nonnegative integer. Numeric plural selector; print it ungrouped via {count}.

ui.agents.starters.action.all_count.role: Trailing action label on available-built-ins shortcut row
ui.agents.starters.action.all_count.length_hint: Shares one row with available; about 12 characters plus digits.
ui.agents.starters.action.all_count.note: Starts installing all available built-ins. The numeric count is the same total displayed by available, not a completed-install count.
ui.agents.starters.action.all_count.plural_guidance: Use CLDR branches needed by the target language (for example ru/pl few and many; ar zero, two, few and many). Keep {count} ungrouped in every branch: use the plain argument, never # or {count, number}, to preserve identifier-like receipt counts.

placeholders.count: Total built-ins the action will attempt, equal to available.count; nonnegative integer. Numeric plural selector; print it ungrouped via {count}.

ui.agents.starters.progress.accessible.role: Accessible label of the determinate installation progress meter
ui.agents.starters.progress.accessible.tone: Complete description for a screen reader.
ui.agents.starters.progress.accessible.length_hint: Screen-reader text only; no visible width budget.
ui.agents.starters.progress.accessible.note: Names progress while a batch is running. step is the current one-based attempt; total is the whole batch size.

placeholders.step: One-based index of the attempt in flight, converted to an ungrouped digit string.
placeholders.total: Total attempt count for this batch, converted to an ungrouped digit string.

ui.agents.starters.progress.named.role: Visible running-install status with the active built-in name
ui.agents.starters.progress.named.tone: Quiet in-progress sentence; retain the ellipsis.
ui.agents.starters.progress.named.length_hint: One compact status line under the meter; may wrap for a long identifier.
ui.agents.starters.progress.named.note: Shown while an agent name is in flight. Describes the current attempt, not a completed count.

placeholders.step: One-based index of the attempt in flight, converted to an ungrouped digit string.
placeholders.total: Total attempt count for this batch, converted to an ungrouped digit string.
placeholders.name: Canonical built-in identifier currently being installed; unchanged and unquoted here.

ui.agents.starters.progress.count.role: Visible running-install status between named attempts
ui.agents.starters.progress.count.tone: Quiet in-progress sentence, not the terminal receipt.
ui.agents.starters.progress.count.length_hint: One compact status line under the meter, about 20 characters plus two numbers.
ui.agents.starters.progress.count.note: Shown when no current name is available; done counts completed attempts. The ellipsis means the batch is still running.

placeholders.total: Total attempt count for this batch, converted to an ungrouped digit string.
placeholders.done: Completed attempt count (successes, skips and failures), converted to an ungrouped digit string.

ui.agents.starters.action.done.role: Button dismissing the finished installation receipt
ui.agents.starters.action.done.note: Appears after the batch ends; receives focus, then returns focus to the original install shortcut when dismissed. It does not install anything.
